name: Expandable Card
description: Mathematical FLIP morphing card dialog with zero Framer Motion dependencies, zero layout shifts, and accessible dialog semantics.

vue.description: Vue 3 Expandable Card outer adapter wrapping @exhuma/core headless primitive.
vue.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ExpandableCard as ExpandableCardPrimitive } from '@exhuma/core';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

interface Props {
  class?: string;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  class: '',
});
</script>

<template>
  <ExpandableCardPrimitive
    v-bind="props"
    :class="cn('relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-6 shadow-sm transition-shadow hover:shadow-md cursor-pointer', props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </ExpandableCardPrimitive>
</template>

svelte.description: Svelte 5 Expandable Card adapter using runes and @exhuma/core primitives.
svelte.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { ExpandableCard as ExpandableCardPrimitive } from '@exhuma/core';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  let {
    class: className = '',
    children,
    ...restProps
  }: {
    class?: string;
    children?: import('svelte').Snippet;
    [key: string]: unknown;
  } = $props();
</script>

<ExpandableCardPrimitive
  class={cn('relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-6 shadow-sm transition-shadow hover:shadow-md cursor-pointer', className)}
  {...restProps}
>
  {@render children?.()}
</ExpandableCardPrimitive>
